conflicts.topic: historical Polish AML registration vs current MiCA authorisation
conflicts.resolvedFinding: The 2022 Binance Poland virtual-currency register entry is historical AML/VASP registration and cannot be used as current MiCA CASP authorisation after 2026-07-01.

conflicts.topic: visible PLN/P2P/spot surfaces vs legal/account availability
conflicts.resolvedFinding: Technical/public reachability is proven, but Poland-resident onboarding and legal service availability remain under review.
limitations: No account testing; current ESMA authorised-CASP CSV row not independently parsed.

conflicts.topic: current MiCA status: primary register landing page vs secondary current reporting
conflicts.resolvedFinding: Secondary sources report Binance still lacked EU approval in July/August 2026, but this run did not directly parse the ESMA CASP row set; positive authorisation remains unconfirmed.

conflicts.topic: global owner-confirmed referral link/code vs Poland offer eligibility
conflicts.resolvedFinding: Commercial link/code ownership is not evidence of Poland-specific campaign eligibility or exchange availability.
